landing.h2: A smart feed that knows the difference between a permission slip and a birthday invite. Syncs with your calendar, answers your smart assistant, and eliminates the clutter without missing what matters.
landing.h3: Smart feed for family logistics. No points. Photos stay in the class.
landing.lead: Ask Home or Grok what school is tomorrow. Open the feed only when you want the photos.
landing.ask: Ask Home or Grok what school is tomorrow.
landing.pillar1_lead: Not all messages deserve a push. Smart filtering by context.
landing.pillar1_late: I'm running 10 minutes late routes only to the teacher, never clutters the parent feed.
landing.pillar1_social: Birthday invitations tagged Social in a dedicated folder.
landing.pillar1_action: Excursion slips flagged Action Required and added to calendar.
landing.pillar2_title: Ask Your Assistant for the Weekly Rundown
landing.pillar2_body: Stop scrolling. Ask Alexa/smart speaker for the week. AI summarizes: field trip Wednesday, birthday Thursday, rain boots Friday.
landing.pillar3_body: Instant for Absences and Action Items; Social and Photo Dumps as Sunday digest. Prevent overwhelm.
landing.pillar4_body: No gamification. No points. No public feeds. Photos stay in the class. Open-source, self-hostable, free for families.
landing.demo: See the smart feed in action.
consent.public_lead: Calma por defeito. Recusar fotos e o modo YOLO sao escolha do encarregado. Desligado ate os ligares. Nao afirmamos aqui um selo legal.
landing.rgpd_note: Esta pagina nao e um selo RGPD nem um certificado.
landing.yolo_body: Por defeito e calma. As publicacoes ficam no grupo. Partilha publica ou YOLO fica desligada ate um encarregado aceitar. Nao pomos a cara de uma crianca numa pagina aberta.
